scope: The National Museum of Malaysia main building as recorded in January 2008. Includes the long symmetrical palace-inspired roof wings, steep projecting entrance gable with crossed apex and three vertical entrance bays, twin mosaic fields, stairs and side/rear exterior. The museum collections, detached Istana Satu and later MRT station are outside scope. Mosaic fields are represented by generic material without copying the artworks.

primaryWrittenSources.facts: The official museum identifies Ho Kok Hoe’s Malay palace-inspired design, main building completed in 1963, and two Italian glass mosaic spans.

The Department of Museums reports three storeys and 109.7 meters overall length. The text gives 37.6 meters at the central point without labeling its axis. Use mapped plan depths and photo proportions for the modeled vertical section.
